稳定视频扩散（原始稳定版本）

截至撰写本文时，有两个图像到视频检查点。以下是官方检查站调整为生成 14 帧视频的一个和25 帧视频的一个。将它们放在 ComfyUI/models/checkpoints 文件夹中。

使用图像到视频模型的最基本方法是为其提供一个初始图像，如以下使用 14 帧模型的工作流程所示。您可以下载此 webp 动画图像并加载或拖动它舒适用户界面以获得工作流程。



对参数的一些解释：

video_frames：要生成的视频帧数。

motion_bucket_id：数字越大，视频中的运动越多。

fps：fps 越高，视频的断断续续就越少。

增强级别：添加到初始图像的噪声量，越高，视频看起来就越不像初始图像。增加它以获得更多运动。

VideoLinearCFGGuidance：该节点稍微改进了这些视频模型的采样，它的作用是跨不同帧线性缩放 cfg。在上面的示例中，第一帧将为 cfg 1.0（节点中的 min_cfg），中间帧为 1.75，最后一帧为 2.5。 （采样器中设置的 cfg）。这样，距离初始帧较远的帧会获得逐渐较高的 cfg。

重新发布，可从：
https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt/tree/main

Stable Video Diffusion (Original Stability Release)

As of writing this there are two image to video checkpoints. Here are the official checkpoints forthe one tuned to generate 14 frame videosandthe one for 25 frame videos. Put them in the ComfyUI/models/checkpoints folder.

The most basic way of using the image to video model is by giving it an init image like in the folowing workflow that uses the 14 frame model. You can download this webp animated image and load it or drag it onComfyUIto get the workflow.



Some explanations for the parameters:

video_frames: The number of video frames to generate.

motion_bucket_id: The higher the number the more motion will be in the video.

fps: The higher the fps the less choppy the video will be.

augmentation level: The amount of noise added to the init image, the higher it is the less the video will look like the init image. Increase it for more motion.

VideoLinearCFGGuidance: This node improves sampling for these video models a bit, what it does is linearly scale the cfg across the different frames. In the above example the first frame will be cfg 1.0 (the min_cfg in the node) the middle frame 1.75 and the last frame 2.5. (the cfg set in the sampler). This way frames further away from the init frame get a gradually higher cfg.

Repost, available from:
https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt/tree/main
